headline: Argentina beat England 2-1 to reach World Cup final for second consecutive time
summary: Goals from Enzo Fernandez and Lautaro Martinez secured the victory at Atlanta Stadium, setting up a clash with Spain in the mega final.
details: Argentina defeated England 2-1 in the second semi-final of the FIFA World Cup, securing a spot in the mega final for the second consecutive tournament.
The match, held at Atlanta Stadium on Wednesday, saw England take an early lead in the 55th minute through a goal by Anthony Gordon, assisted by Morgan Rogers.
The first half ended in a goal-less draw despite 19 fouls being committed, with Argentina committing 12 and England 7.
Argentina fought back in the final 20 minutes of the match, with Enzo Fernandez scoring a stunning long-range shot in the 85th minute to equalize.
The winning goal came in the third minute of second-half injury time, when Lautaro Martinez headed in a cross from Lionel Messi to secure the victory.
Argentina will now face Spain in the mega final this coming Sunday, July 19, at 1:00 AM Bangladesh time, aiming for back-to-back titles.
caption:
From 1-0 down to a dramatic injury-time winner! Argentina beats England to secure a spot in the World Cup final.

Argentina defeated England 2-1 in the second semi-final of the FIFA World Cup, securing a spot in the mega final for the second consecutive tournament.

The match, held at Atlanta Stadium on Wednesday, saw England take an early lead in the 55th minute through a goal by Anthony Gordon, assisted by Morgan Rogers.

The first half ended in a goal-less draw despite 19 fouls being committed, with Argentina committing 12 and England 7.

Argentina fought back in the final 20 minutes of the match, with Enzo Fernandez scoring a stunning long-range shot in the 85th minute to equalize.

The winning goal came in the third minute of second-half injury time, when Lautaro Martinez headed in a cross from Lionel Messi to secure the victory.

Argentina will now face Spain in the mega final this coming Sunday, July 19, at 1:00 AM Bangladesh time, aiming for back-to-back titles.
